purpose: Anchor schema-kind registry epochs so schema_type_of(record_id) is resolved from hash-bound registry commits, not mutable local claims.
resolution_algorithm: Load registry epoch by explicit registry_epoch_id.
Resolve schema_id to kind from registry entries only.
Ignore payload-declared kind for authority decisions.
Reject records whose schema_id is absent, duplicated, or hash-mismatched.
invariants: Kind authority comes from anchored registry epochs, not payloads.
Registry forks are explicit epochs, not silent mutations.
Schema-kind mappings are replay inputs and must be hash-bound.
The validator is only constitutional when its registry epoch is pinned.
No record may upgrade its own authority by declaring its own kind.
